description: 黑后牺牲拦截白兵，打开g路赢白后
explanation_en: Black sacrifices the queen to block the white pawn, opening the g-file for a pawn to capture White's queen.

intro.popup: 💡 拦截：黑方行动！白后在f6，白兵在h3和g4。黑后跳g4，能牺牲拦截h3兵，让g7兵吃掉白后吗？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Interference: Black to move. White's queen is on f6, with pawns on h3 and g4. Can Black sacrifice the queen on g4 to block the h3-pawn and let the g7-pawn capture White's queen?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Qg4！后牺牲跳g4，hxg4被迫拦截黑后，g7兵gxf6吃掉白后——妙！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Qg4! sacrifices the queen and blocks the h-pawn. After hxg4, the g7-pawn captures White's queen with ...gxf6.

moves.popup: 黑后Qg4！后牺牲跳到g4——站在g4，引诱白h3兵来吃，同时g7兵将可gxf6！
moves.popup_en: Qg4! Black sacrifices the queen on g4, tempting White's h-pawn to capture it and allowing the g7-pawn to take White's queen with ...gxf6.

moves.popup: 白兵hxg4——吃掉黑后，但白兵现在站在g4，拦截了白后f6的g路逃跑！
moves.popup_en: hxg4 captures Black's queen, but the white pawn now blocks the g-file escape route for the queen on f6.

moves.popup: 黑兵gxf6！g7兵吃掉白后——拦截战术完成，黑方大获！
moves.popup_en: ...gxf6! The pawn from g7 captures White's queen. The interference tactic succeeds, and Black wins decisively.
